svg.title: OnlyBlocks getBlock pipeline
svg.desc: A getBlock request is validated, resolved to a CAR byte range through a 12-byte slot-ranges.raw record, fetched with an HTTP Range read, indexed as CARv1, walked as DAG-CBOR, given a previousBlockhash from the parent slot, and its metadata is reassembled from DataFrames, Zstandard-decompressed and decoded as Protobuf or Bincode before JSON serialization. Two RAM LRU caches hold slot ranges and blockhashes. Nothing touches disk.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: OnlyBlocks · one getBlock, end to end

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: single process · bounded RAM · 0 disk bytes
